findings.reason: the asserted refusal is not reachable at the batch call, so the done-when must either assert the admission-time hold or the deliverable must declare the queue-time check, and either edit changes what a node builds.
findings.text: s12's done-when asserts that the batch entry without `allow_unreviewed_plan`, under the enforced gate, "is refused on the review gate", but the batch path writes requests through `queue_requests` (`reckon/crew/dispatch_batch.py:725`), which checks the admission domain and `validate_node` only (`reckon/crew/dispatch.py:341`) and never consults the plan-review gate; the gate's refusal site is the direct-dispatch planner (`reckon/crew/dispatch_plan.py:911`, reached before any queue write at `reckon/crew/dispatch.py:1125`), while a queued request is only HELD at admission (`reckon/crew/queue_admission.py:4915,5572`). The deliverable says the unwaived entry "behaves as now", so a node either fails its own gate or adds an unrequested queue-time refusal
